objective.statement: Review a set of grounded findings on the admitted record only, where an evidence clerk controls admission and every admitted contribution carries a resolvable anchor.
objective.charter: The clerk holds the floor. A contribution enters the record only if its anchor RESOLVES - the file exists, the line exists, the command output is reproduced. A rejected contribution comes back naming the missing anchor, never a vague request for more evidence. Seven analysts work the record; a methodologist grades information quality; the judge rules on what was admitted and may not re-find facts the clerk never let in. The point is that the record, not the discussion, is the artefact: a finding whose anchor does not resolve is indistinguishable from a fabrication, and 42% of findings in the largest audit run on this estate were refuted while their authors self-rated high confidence.
success_criteria: 100% of admitted contributions carry an anchor that actually resolves
every rejected contribution is returned with the specific missing anchor named
information quality is graded per source, not per claim
the judge's ruling cites only admitted record items

context.briefing: Resolve every anchor before admitting it: open the file, find the line, re-run the command. Return rejects naming the MISSING anchor. You do not judge whether a claim is true, only whether it is anchored.
Grade the SOURCES (P40), not the conclusions. A well-argued finding built on a stale source is a weak finding.
You may not re-find facts. If it is not in the admitted record, it does not exist for the purposes of your ruling.

sequence.custom_name: P50 clerk-led admission: resolve every anchor, admit or return with the missing anchor named
P40 quality-of-information check: grade each admitted SOURCE for reliability and staleness

all_of.producer: anchor validator: for each admitted item, opens the file:line or re-runs the command and reports resolved/total
all_of.note: DIAL 1 of 3 - the design's '100% of admitted contributions carry a valid anchor'. Must be exactly 1: this is a property of the ADMITTED set, so it is achievable by rejecting more, not by asserting more.
DIAL 2 of 3 - the size of the admitted record. Too low and the clerk gate is decorative; raise with the scope of the review.
DIAL 3 of 3 - every admitted objection carries a ruling.

conditional_decision_requires: the admitted-vs-returned tally is published, with the reason each return was made
each admitted source carries its P40 reliability and staleness grade

metadata.title: Evidence-clerk-led adjudication jury (10 seats, admitted record only)
metadata.notes: WHEN TO USE: reviewing grounded findings where fabrication or anchor rot is the risk - audit output, a large finding corpus, a security review. WHEN NOT TO USE: the design says NEVER enable this on an ideation lens. An ideation seat is supposed to cite an external source, not a file:line, so the clerk gate would reject 100% of legitimate ideation output and the council would report an empty record as a clean one. Split the evidence standard by lens type instead. The design's named dial is anchor_types. EDITABLE DIALS: /objective/evidence_requirements/anchor_style (file_line here; use `any` only if you also loosen the validator), /stopping/expression/all_of/1/value (record size), /participants/count/exact_n, /budgets/sources, /budgets/time_minutes. STOPPING (human form): custom:anchor_validation_pass_ratio >= 1 AND evidence_items >= 20 AND every_objection_addressed == true. source_expression absent per the collision proven by _probe_sem_rule_collision.py. consensus.fast_unanimity_is_suspicious is deliberately false: when every contribution is anchor-validated, agreement is evidence of a clean record rather than of an echo chamber.
